verdict.rationale: Sentry's web API docs say it can be used to 'manage and export data', so programmatic export is possible. A free self-hosted edition gives users somewhere to run Sentry outside the SaaS. However, the evidence never documents a complete, bulk, open-format export, and the only relocation tooling cited moves data from self-hosted into SaaS, not out of it. Missing for 10: documented export of ALL data, explicit open/standard export formats (e.g. OTLP/JSON dumps), SaaS-to-self-hosted or offboarding relocation tooling, independent or hands-on corroboration of a successful exit.
